title: A hierarchical society: peninsulares, criollos and castas
goal: Read how colonial society was divided into ranked groups, and use relative clauses with a preposition to describe them.

items: Use *el que*, *la que*, *los que* and *las que* after a preposition to describe colonial groups.
Say who the criollos and the peninsulares were.
Say what many historians think about the casta paintings.
Use the key words of the hierarchy: classification, tax, hierarchy and to belong.
I can use *el que*, *la que*, *los que* and *las que* after a preposition to describe colonial groups.

I can say what colonial law separated.
